Apple's gross profit (which it calls "gross margin") for fiscal Q4 2024, the quarter ended September 28, 2024, was about **$43.88 billion**. I'm working from memory of Apple's 10-K and earnings release, and I didn't run a search to confirm the figures.

- Net sales were $94,930 million.
- Total cost of sales was $51,051 million.
- Gross profit was therefore $94,930M − $51,051M = $43,879 million.
- That works out to a gross margin of about 46.2%.
